preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 668.
The length of the permutation n must be between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= n for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: All elements in the permutation p must be distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output permutation p_prime must have the same length as the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: any(p[i] != p_prime[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p_prime must differ from the input permutation p at least at one position.

postconditions.expression: sorted([p[i] + p[i+1] for i in range(n-1)]) == sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i+1] for i in range(n-1)])
postconditions.description: The fingerprint F(p_prime) must be equal to the fingerprint F(p).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_prime_i <= n for p_prime_i in p_prime)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output permutation p_prime must be distinct integers from 1 to n.
